description:
## Scope
Complete end-to-end matrix using deterministic fake and limited-capability backends: facade/action/plugin/directive/agent ReAct/standalone ReAct/other strategies and child workers/tool followups/repair. Cover selection precedence, option leakage, concurrent isolation, local model references, transformed model options, unsupported operations and malformed callback results.
Exercise stream content/reasoning/tool-fragment/content-part fidelity, final usage/finish reasons, incomplete responses, mid-stream errors, cancellation while blocked, early halt, callback exceptions and owner death. Assert session cleanup and backend/model binding. Preserve Jido.AI.Test scripted APIs. Verify old and new checkpoint cases with independent fixtures and secret/live-resource exclusions.
Add AST-aware architectural enforcement over production lib: executable ReqLLM generation/embedding/stream/model/provider/session/options integration is allowed only in Backends.ReqLLM and its owned submodules. Resolve aliases and review dynamic apply/module patterns. Maintain narrow function-level allowance for shared pure data helpers: a ReqLLM.Response namespace allowance must NOT permit provider-decoding helpers that resolve models/providers. Pair static checks with runtime tests forbidding ReqLLM execution/model calls on custom backend paths.
Add backend identity to relevant telemetry without event-name/result-shape changes or secret disclosure; labels use selected backend metadata. New boundary errors follow existing Error conventions, preserving adapter errors and action sanitization.

## Acceptance criteria
- Full matrix proves no default backend leakage, including hidden repair and followup calls.
- Boundary test fails on an intentionally introduced unauthorized call.
- Existing default regression suites pass with exact documented public contracts.
- Final validation: mix precommit, full stable mix test, Credo, Dialyzer; record commands/results and remaining blockers in issue comments.
- Tests do not require network/API keys/Nx model downloads.

## Suggested commit
test(backend): enforce isolation and checkpoint compatibility
title: Verify backend isolation, compatibility and runtime lifecycle
